title: Tavily API key (tvly-): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: one identifier character before tvly-, so the key is embedded in a longer token and boundary: tvly_ in place of the tvly- delimiter. Twin of "Tavily API key (tvly-): must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of tavily-api-key-js-client: boundary: one identifier character before tvly-, so the key is embedded in a longer token. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
